title: The section conjecture for generic pointed curves
summary: Let $k/\mathbb Q$ be finitely generated, let $g\geq3$ and $n\geq1$, and let $\mathcal M_{g,n/k}$ be the moduli stack of smooth proper genus-$g$ curves with $n$ distinct ordered markings. Put $K=k(\mathcal M_{g,n/k})$. We prove Grothendieck's section conjecture for the generic $n$-pointed genus-$g$ curve over $K$. Over both the moduli stack and its function field, the continuous sections of the arithmetic fundamental-group extension of the universal complete curve are, up to geometric conjugacy, exactly the $n$ tautological sections.
